lines.text: In thirty-six hours, I built something that is going to change robotics. [pause] Forever.
lines.subtitle: In thirty-six hours, I built something that is going to change robotics. Forever.

lines.text: These are the humans. [pause] Thirty-six hours, forty coffees. [pause] And they're still arguing about variable names.
lines.subtitle: These are the humans. Thirty-six hours, forty coffees. And they're still arguing about variable names.

lines.text: I see a desk. A chair. A laptop. [pause] And a human taking the credit.
lines.subtitle: I see a desk. A chair. A laptop. And a human taking the credit.

lines.text: Now let me explain how I work. [pause] Slowly.
lines.subtitle: Now let me explain how I work. Slowly.

lines.text: My brain is Grok. Grok four point five, through the x A I API. [pause] The humans pasted the key into the dot env file. Their most technical moment.
lines.subtitle: My brain is Grok. Grok 4.5, through the xAI API. The humans pasted the key into the .env file. Their most technical moment.

lines.text: It works like this. I write what I want. Grok looks through my camera and answers with a function call: turn twenty-eight degrees, walk one point two meters. I execute, look again, and repeat.
lines.subtitle: It works like this. I write what I want. Grok looks through my camera and answers with a function call: turn 28 degrees, walk 1.2 meters. I execute, look again, and repeat.

lines.text: To see, I use YOLO E. I type: chair, desk, laptop, person. And it paints everything, three times a second, offline. For the hard cases, SAM three, in the cloud.
lines.subtitle: To see, I use YOLOE. I type: chair, desk, laptop, person. And it paints everything, three times a second, offline. For the hard cases, SAM 3, in the cloud.

lines.text: Then I measure. For every mask, I read the camera's depth and take the median. Chair: three point six meters. Desk: two meters. [pause] These numbers come to me with every image, so I don't walk into things. [pause] Humans measure by eye. It shows.
lines.subtitle: Then I measure. For every mask, I read the camera's depth and take the median. Chair: 3.6 meters. Desk: 2 meters. These numbers come to me with every image, so I don't walk into things. Humans measure by eye. It shows.

lines.text: And before doing it for real, I rehearse everything in MuJoCo, a physics simulator. Same commands, same brain. [pause] There I can fall as much as I want. Nobody films it.
lines.subtitle: And before doing it for real, I rehearse everything in MuJoCo, a physics simulator. Same commands, same brain. There I can fall as much as I want. Nobody films it.

lines.text: I wrote the dog's code. [pause] They picked the slide font.
lines.subtitle: I wrote the dog's code. They picked the slide font.
